_tenDayTrendNote: Every series' positions 0-8 are the mathematical carry-forward of 2026-09-10's own committed trend (shift left by one), the same chain-trust approach used on 2026-09-09/2026-09-10. Position 9 (today) for answerRatePct/accepted/missed is a genuinely new reading, corroborated two ways: (1) directly from this report's own confirmed cover totals (accepted=209, missed=20, answer rate=209/229=91%), and (2) the chain-derived values for positions 0,1,2,4,6,8,9 exactly match the surviving (non-dropped) values in today's own garbled chart text for each series — strong cross-confirmation. overallAvgWaitSec's new point (28) has no distinguishable leftover figure in the garbled chart text at all this time (unlike 2026-09-10, which had one) — carried forward unchanged from 2026-09-10's own new point as a low-confidence placeholder.
_queuesNote: Same chain-trust method as the top-level tenDayTrend. Newest-day (position 9) accepted+missed for every queue are confirmed via the day's own accepted-by-queue and missed-by-queue composition pie charts (Appointments 113/11, General Enquiries 94/9, Canberra Vasectomy 2/0, Health Professionals 0/0), all four of which sum exactly to the day's confirmed 209 accepted / 20 missed. Per-queue avgWaitSec newest-day values are lower confidence, same limitation as 2026-09-10's own note: Appointments and Canberra Vasectomy/General Enquiries each carry forward their prior day's value unchanged (42, 44, 35) — their chart text left either no clearly-attributable leftover number, or multiple ambiguous candidates that couldn't be confidently assigned to a single queue/day. Health Professionals (0) is carried forward and independently expected, given zero calls today.
